title.narrative: Promoting Access to Finance for Productive Purposes for MSMEs

description.narrative: The objective of the Promoting Access to Finance for Productive Purposes for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises Project for Ecuador is to promote access to finance for productive purposes for micro, small and medium enterprises in the context of the COVID-19 crisis. The Project has four main components. 1. Strengthening the institutional capacity of National Finance Corporation (CFN) component will provide technical assistance and capacity building to CFN. Under this component the Project will finance, inter alia: (a) Design of a corporate governance strengthening plan for CFN; (b) Assessment of the financial viability of CFN to ascertain the net present value of its assets; (c) Assessment of the current strategy of CFN and development of an updated business plan to align with the results of the corporate governance reform and the financial viability assessment; (d) Design and implementation of a monitoring and evaluation strategy to measure the effect of access to credit on final borrowers, including female-owned enterprises and first-time borrowers; (e) Design and implementation of an environmental and social management system and standards for CFN's second-tier lending; and (f) Technical assistance to strengthen the capacity of financial intermediaries accessing second-tier financial products, including the strengthening of their environmental and social management systems. 2. Development and Improvement of Financial Products to Promote Access to Finance for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) component will support CFN to develop new or improve existing financial products to promote access to finance for productive purposes, especially for MSMEs. This component has three subcomponents. Under 2a. Technical assistance subcomponent, the Project will finance a technical assistance to, inter alia: (i) strengthen NGF; and (ii) design, test and evaluate new financial products for MSMEs. 2b Capitalization of NGF for special COVID-19 program subcomponent will support the activation of a special emergency guarantee program to alleviate the economic effects of the COVID-19 crisis on productive MSMEs. 2c Capitalization of National Guarantee Fund (NGF) for standard programs subcomponent will support the standard operations of NGF. 3. Credit Line Intermediated by CFN to PFIs for On-Lending to MSMEs component will support CFN to establish and expand second-tier lending operations to serve MSMEs through the commercial and the cooperative banking sector. Under this component, the Project will finance the provision of lines of credit to eligible private PFIs, which in turn will on-lend to eligible private MSMEs. 4. Project Management component will focus on supporting CFN to effectively execute the Project. Under this component, the Project will finance, inter alia: (a) Recruitment and training of the Project Coordination Team (PCT) members including, if necessary, specialists responsible for procurement procedures, financial management, environmental and social management, and the overall execution of the Project; (b) Acquisition of equipment and furniture for the Project Coordination Team (PCT); (c) Monitoring and evaluation activities; (d) Study tours for relevant CFN staff; (e) Stakeholder and citizen engagement plan, including implementation of a Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM); (f) Communication strategy; and (g) Project's financial audits.
The project development objective is to promote access to finance for productive purposes for micro, small and medium enterprises in the context of the COVID-19 crisis.
